parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

parameters.name: CenRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region in which the routing policy is applied.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RouteMapId
parameters.description: The ID of the routing policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn delete-cen-route-map --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jm0000 --cen-region-id cn-hangzhou --route-map-id cenrmap-abcdedfghij0000 --region cn-hangzhou
